traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Oxalidales page (read 2026-10-16): Oxalidaceae spiral/two-ranked, Elaeocarpaceae spiral or opposite, Connaraceae spiral/two-ranked; Cunoniaceae and Brunellia opposite.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Oxalidales page (read 2026-10-16): spiral in Oxalidaceae, Elaeocarpaceae, Cephalotus; two-ranked in Connaraceae and Huaceae (or spiral); opposite in Cunoniaceae.

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Oxalidales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): leaves compound, odd-pinnate; Elaeocarpaceae (~770 spp.) and Huaceae simple.

traits.division_pattern.note: APweb, Oxalidales page (read 2026-10-16): order odd-pinnate (Cunoniaceae, Connaraceae, Brunellia, Averrhoa); Oxalis trifoliolate/palmate.

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Oxalidales page (read 2026-10-16): woody families; Oxalis many bulbous herbs, Cephalotus rhizomatous herb with basal pitchers.

traits.life_span.note: APweb, Oxalidales page (read 2026-10-16): trees, shrubs, lianes; Oxalis herbs mostly perennial (bulbs, rhizomes); some annual Oxalis (my knowledge).

traits.leaf_habit.note: APweb, Oxalidales page (read 2026-10-16): Huaceae evergreen; Elaeocarpaceae, Cunoniaceae, Connaraceae tropical/southern woody plants, evergreen from my knowledge. For bulbous Oxalis the trait is ill-defined (seasonally dormant).

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb, Oxalidales page (read 2026-10-16): Elaeocarpaceae racemes or solitary in axils; Huaceae axillary. Oxalis axillary peduncles (my knowledge).

traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb, Oxalidales page (read 2026-10-16): Connaraceae radially symmetric; Oxalis, Cunoniaceae radial. Connaraceae 'zygomorphic often' as stated seems doubtful.

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb, Oxalidales page (read 2026-10-16): broad hypanthium only in Cephalotus; none described for the larger families.

traits.ovary_position.note: APweb, Oxalidales page (read 2026-10-16): no inferior ovaries described; Elaeocarpaceae and Cunoniaceae state rare exceptions.

traits.carpels.note: APweb, Oxalidales page (read 2026-10-16): Oxalidaceae usually 5, Connaraceae up to 5 free, Elaeocarpaceae 2-9, Cunoniaceae 2-6, Huaceae 5.

traits.fruit_type.note: APweb, Oxalidales page (read 2026-10-16): loculicidal capsule (Oxalidaceae, Elaeocarpaceae), septicidal capsule (Cunoniaceae), follicles (Connaraceae, Brunellia), drupes.

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb, Oxalidales page (read 2026-10-16): Oxalis heterostylous bisexual; dioecy in parts of Cunoniaceae and Connaraceae.
